name: Clemente Biondetti
features: weathered olive skin, dark hair swept back, deep-set dark eyes, long lined face, wiry build, stubborn patient expression
bio: Born to a working-class Sardinian family, Biondetti raced motorcycles before cars and became the greatest road racer of his generation: four Mille Miglia victories, in 1938, 1947, 1948 and 1949. He raced into his fifties and never lost the road-racer's habit of memorising an entire thousand-mile route.
